result.summary: The food delivery home screen is mostly well laid out. One clear visual defect was found: the restaurant title 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' list is clipped mid-word ('Tokumaru Rameı') even though there is ample horizontal space before the rating badge, indicating a text container width/overflow bug rather than intentional truncation.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Tokumaru Ramen' in the 'Popular right now' section is hard-clipped to 'Tokumaru Rameı' — the final letter is cut off with no ellipsis, despite plenty of free space between the title and the rating (4.8) on the right. This is not an edge-of-screen scroll clip; it is a mis-sized title container overflowing/clipping its own text.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title text view to expand to the available width (e.g., flex: 1 with the rating badge as a fixed-size sibling) and apply ellipsis truncation only when the text truly exceeds the space; verify the container has no fixed pixel width.
